szoveg_eredeti:
Today we’re opening the ElevenLabs Marketplace, launching with partners including Salesforce , IBM , NiCE , Twilio , and Zendesk .

Enterprises can now explore agents and applications built on ElevenLabs across financial services, insurance, healthcare, telecommunications, retail, and more. 

 Zendesk built an agent that resolves customer service requests from start to finish. Assort Health automates scheduling and inbound patient calls. Consio 's voice agents handle support and orders for Shopify brands in 70 languages.
